title: Freezing Calderón: Robust Preconditioning for Maxwell Scattering under Shape Uncertainty
summary: Calderón preconditioning restores mesh-independent conditioning for boundary-element discretizations of the Maxwell electric field integral equation, but assembling the dual barycentric operator can dominate the computational cost. We show that this preconditioner can be assembled once at a nominal geometry and reused across connectivity-preserving shape perturbations. Exact combinatorial alignment of the RWG-BC degrees of freedom transports the duality pairing, leaving only the dual-mesh operator frozen.
